batting.dismissal: st MS Dhoni b P Negi

batting.dismissal: c B Aparajith b DJ Bravo

batting.name: KV Sharma
batting.dismissal: c RA Jadeja b DJ Bravo

batting.dismissal: c GH Vihari b MC Henriques

batting.name: SK Raina
batting.dismissal: c EJG Morgan b MC Henriques

balls.text: the full and slow delivery is lofted high on the leg side, Jadeja in the cow corner stays calm in the deep and takes it easily. Third wicket for the DJ
towards middle and leg stump from back of length, Karn wants to smack it to leg but gets an inside edge past the stumps to fine-leg boundary for four
straight to short third man for catching practice! Vihari opened up, Bravo pitched it full around off and the batsman steered ti straight to the substitute fielder B Aparajith
full on the off stump, Morgan comes down and drills it to long off
bangs it in slightly short, he slams it back past the bowler to long on
slow offcutter outside off, Morgan heaves on the leg side and finds wide long on
short ball just outside off, slapped back past the bowler towards long off for two

McCullum drops a catch, yes it's true! Morgan mistimed that one as he swivelled on the leg side, the top edge went very high on the off side. Baz at point called for it and the ball was nowhere close to his hands as he closed them
Dhoni and Mohit appeal for caught behind, umpire says no and signals for first bouncer. It was a slower bouncer on the leg stump, Morgan looked to hook it and looks like he missed it
that's gone absolutely flat, almost a six! Too full outside off with a lot of room and Morgan swung his arms freely to drive that wide of deep point for a one-bounce four
short ball now, Morgan doesn't time the pull that well but finds the gap between deep midwicket and long on for two
pitches it up and Morgan launches it high in the air, it lands somewhere in the crowd over the long on boundary! It was in his zone and he tonked it very high and far away
slow at 117.4kph, it's way too short outside off, Vihari hops on his toes and ramps that over the slip region for four. Clever shot
slower ball again outside off, Morgan drives it into the covers for one
slow and full on the stumps, Vihari comes down and drives it straight to mid off. Baz launches a throw from there which wasn't too far from Vihar's head at the bowler's end
98.3kmh, slow and on length on middle stump, Morgan waits and pushes it down to long off

105.5kph, slower ball foxes him to get a wicket! Bravo sent down a short of length offcutter outside off, Reddy threw his bat at it and mistimed it completely to top edge it towards the slips. Dhoni came under it to pouch it
short delivery from Bravo, Reddy pivots on the back foot and pulls it wide of deep square leg for four in the gap
fullish outside off, driven straight to Bravo at cover
full into the pads now, Morgan flicks it with the wrists to deep square leg for only one
manages to turn the short ball towards midwicket for a quick single
gives him the charge to take it on the full, drives it straight to cover
angled across the batsman outside off, he swings and misses
deflects onto the stumps, Ojha is gone! Nehra angled it into the pads, Ojha looked to heave that to the leg side and it deflects off the pads to the off stump
136.4kph, length delivery angled outside off, swing and a miss
angled in towards off, Ojha opens up and cuts it late to third man for one
full and straight, Ojha moves towards leg a bit and lofts it straight over the long off fielder for a six into the second tier
back of length outside the off stump, Ojha swings and misses
full toss down the leg side for a wide
it wasn't a bad ball, on length around off, and Ojha heaved it effortlessly to the wide long on boundary for four
pretty full on middle stump, pushed down to mid off
back of length on the stumps, Morgan bunts it towards midwicket for a quick single
he needs a couple of lessons on outside edges. Looks to drive, misses it completely

this one is off the middle! Just a push towards extra cover and this was threatening to run away very very quickly. This is why he is the best timer of the ball in India, bar Rohit Sharma. Bravo dives to save a certain boundary at mid-off
another superb outside edge! Ojha tests Nehra at third man again but he is not going to get there
big outside edge and this runs away to the third-man boundary! No slips here.
he bangs it short again, Morgan packs some power in that pull but it goes to deep midwicket after a bounce
slow and full offcutter again, Ojha drills it back down the ground and Bravo stops it with his right ankle to fall on the ground. Every dot ball counts
fullish on the off stump, pushed back to the bowler
pushes the slower offcutter from outside off to point, says no for the run
seam movement for the length delivery outside off, Ojha pokes and misses
back of length slower ball on leg, clipped off the pads to deep square leg for one
full around off, Morgan drives the ball straight to cover

that's a bizarre run out, Dhawan is gone! He flicked the ball from middle to deep midwicket and for some reason they thought of taking the second run. Accurate throw and he's run out by a mile. The throw was Jadeja's after all
quick on length around off, driven down to long off for one
slides this one flat on off, Morgan cuts it to backward point
charges down to take it on the full, drives it firmly back to the bowler who stops it
length delivery towards off stump, pushed straight to cover
straighter delivery on middle stump, tucked to leg for one
it's full, it's lofted down the ground, it's six! Morgan had to drive that one straight down the ground since it was pitched up, he did so and nearly hit the sight screen
reverse-sweeps the ball from outside off past the keeper for one
very tough chance put down by Negi! Dhawan slammed that full delivery back to the bowler around chest height and Negi couldn't hold on to it
errs down the leg side and Dhawan takes advantage of that by swiping it past short fine leg from middle and leg for four
gets a fuller one now and it's drilled down to long off
back of length outside off, Morgan slams and gets a bottom edge to the bowler
full on the stumps and it's pushed down the ground to long off
full on middle and leg with the angle, pushed to midwicket
drives this one with a straight bat down to long off for one
makes a lot of room again, gets one short and cuts it from outside leg past short third man and backward point for four
exposes all his stumps by going down leg, Raina follows him with a very wide ball and it's actually a wide down leg
full on Morgan's pads now, he steers the ball to deep square leg
Dhawan comes down, Raina bowls on the pads and he clips it square on the leg side for one
Henriques' cameo is over, stumped! He came down the track, Negi made it flatter outside off, the batsman pushes and missed it. MS Dhoni does the rest
on length just outside off, Dhawan drives it down to long off too
low full toss on off, driven down firmly to long off for one
flights a tad outside off, Henriques drives the ball handsomely inside-out over the covers for a one-bounce four!
turning in a bit from off stump, driven down the ground past the bowler
full outside off, driven square to deep point for one
drives this length delivery down the ground to long off
well and wide outside off, guides it to point
down the track third ball in a raw, takes it on the full and flicks it high on the leg side. It's gone into the crowd for six more
comes down again and pushes it to midwicket now
dances down the track first ball and smacks that over wide long on. That's gone a long long way for six

finally a wicket falls and it's Warner, he holes out to deep backward square leg! He charged down the ground for the ball that was on leg, pulled from the middle of the bat but found Dr Smith in the deep
slower delivery on the leg stump, Warner makes room and clears cover point for one
in the block hole on the stumps, Warner digs it out back to the bowler
heaves on leg and gets an inside edge onto the pads towards square leg for one
length delivery on middle and leg, Dhawan defends it back
typical Dhawan flick with a whip on the leg side, fine leg runs to his left and dives, but Negi can't stop that one despite getting a hand to it
pushes the ball towards short cover, Warner wants a run and runs a fair distance, Dhawan sends him back and Warner gets back in time
length delivery on the stumps, no room, and he defends it back
exposes all his stumps by making a lot of room, cuts it fiercely to deep point
goes down on a knee to sweep, it goes down leg for a wide
tucks the ball with the angle to deep square leg for one
uses his feet to come down and pushes to long on for one
tries to reverse sweep, but the ball is slower and gets the toe end of the bat
slightly slow towards middle and leg, taken on the pads

not too short, not full at all, do'nt know what Warner saw in that and slammed it high on the leg side towards the cow corner. It bounces a couple of times before the boundary and then Mohit cuts it in
137kph, quicker and angled into the pads, Dhawan doesn't get any room and sneaks in a leg bye
slightly full outside off, Dhawan drives it just past short cover towards sweeper cover and comes back in time for the second
low and slow full toss, pushed to midwicket for one
smacked for four more. Short delivery to follow the full one, he opens up again and hammers it over mid on down the ground for four
doesn't matter which end you bowl from. It was full, long-off at the boundary, but Warner clears his front foot and lofts it over the covers for another four. 20-ball 50
just around off now, pushes wide of cover point for a quick single
they're bowling too short to him. This was back of length on the pads, it rises a bit and Warner dabs it past short fine leg with a quick swivel for four more
touch back of length outside off, guides it to third man for one
sometimes Baz can't stop the ball either! Dhawan gets a full delivery outside off, drives it off the middle of the bat through the covers. Baz chases, Baz dives, Baz tries, Baz fails
short ball now on the leg side, pulled with a lot of power and deep midwicket cuts it off
can't stop this man, no chance! This ball gave him only a bit of room outside off, he waits for it and then cuts it delicately between point and short third man. Nobody moves, it's four
slower and back of length ball around off, Warner waits and pushes towards short cover for one
hammers that down the ground again on the off side, but straight to mid on this time
on the leg side now, that's a short-arm powerful and cross-bat swivel on the leg side. Mid-on dives to his left and can't stop it. Warner's on fire, his bat is burning
that's not full at all, but it's in Warner's zone and he opens up to drill it down the ground for a cracking four!
pulls and misses, the ball sneaks through! Warner pulls the back of length delivery, it doesn't bounce as much and goes under the bat, over the stumps
that's a lovely cover drive off the front foot through the covers in the gap. He came down for the outswinger and Faf jumped near the boundary to cut it in
that's sheer timing! Slightly slower towards the pads, Warner merely clips it off the pads gently. Maybe for one or two. Hang on, that goes all the way to beat the fielder
that's a back-foot punch down the ground over mid off for four! Make what you can of that. Back of length outside off, Warner stays back and lofts it uppishly wide and over mid off
straight delivery on length on the stumps, Dhawan pushes it down to mid off
short and slow outside off, he makes room and cuts it over point for one
he stays back this time and smears that over wide long on for six! It was short, it was angling in and he pulled that from the middle
charges down, Mohit replies with a short ball outside off Warner slashes it high in the air on the off side with an upper edge. One-bounce four
room outside off, Dhawan cuts it uppishly over point to third man for one
angled in towards the pads, tucked off the back foot to fine leg for one
wider outside the off stump, bit of room and Dhawan guides it to point
nice shape to take it away a bit as Dhawan goes back to defend the ball in front of middle stump
touch fuller around the off stump, driven down straight to mid off
on length outside off with some outswing, pushed into the covers for one
length delivery angling in a bit towards middle stump, Dhawan pushes it down to mid on for a quick single. Not timed very well and slightly uppish
makes some room to open up and drives that length delivery from off, off the back foot, into the covers for another four
fullish outside off, Dhawan drives it into the covers for one. Didn't come from the middle
touch back of length outside off, pushed straight to extra cover
pushes at the wrong line outside off, gets a thick outside edge towards backward point where Jadeja dives to his right
good swing into the batsman, Warner doesn't get any room and punches it back
short ball and Warner gets into position early, smacks that with a swivel of his bat to the square-leg boundary for a four. Cracking pull
full toss on the pads now, Bravo finds short fine leg with a flick. It's all over
full toss on the off stump, struck down to long on for one
bowling it on middle stump in the block hole like machines, he makes room and drives through the covers
he can hit the block hole too on middle stump, Jadeja pushes it towards mid on
126kph, full and low on the pads, drives it down to long on for one
goes well down the leg side now for a wide
angled in towards the pads, Jadeja tries to heave it to leg and gets a leg bye as it deflects off the pd
full outside off, Bravo makes some room and cleverly taps it late by opening the face of the bat to the third man boundary for four
that's a rare full toss on leg stump, flicked to midwicket this time
Bravo moves across this time and heaves the full delivery from outside off to long on
block hole again on middle stump, Jadeja drives it down to long off. Only one
and in the block hole again, Bravo makes room and drives it from outside leg to deep cover
yorker number 438756 on the middle stump, Jadeja blocks it on the off side for a single
some room offered by Boult outside off and Bravo swings his arms to loft it over the covers for four. That makes it 11 from the over
the full ball on the stumps is drilled down to mid on
full toss on the pads, it deflects off the pads and they come back for the second as it goes to square leg
in the block hole on off and middle, Jads pushes it down to long on for one. A direct hit means it's an overthrow too
almost a yorker on leg stump, Bravo makes room and steers it to point for a quick one
full on the stumps, Jadeja slams it along the ground to the leg side for one
nearly in the block hole on off, Bravo digs it out back to the bowler and Bhuvi stops it
fullish again and he pushes it to long on for one

the stumps are uprooted again, this time at the non-striker's end with a direct hit from Henriques. Jadeja clipped the full delivery to deep midwicket, Moises ran in, picked it up in no time and hit the stumps. Bravo's bat was in by an inch or two
even better yorker, that's unplayable! Negi stayed back in the crease, tried to block it back, but it swung late and uprooted two stumps out of three. What a treat to watch, that ball!
this time Bravo finds cover as Bhuvi delivers in the block hole and he drives it to cover
tries the yorker and he drives that full toss in the gap, just wide of cover for four
Bravo exposes all his stumps with a lot of room, PK delivers it full and on leg, driven down to long on
PK chases Negi again as he makes room, inside edge goes to fine leg for one
falls well short of deep cover as Bravo comes down and lofts the full toss on the off side
fullish again and it's driven down the ground to long on. Warner makes sure it's only one
almost in the block hole outside off, steered to deep cover for one
Negi makes room and PK chases with a low full toss, it's clipped to the leg side for one
slower full toss on middle, clipped to deep midwicket and Negi keeps strike
it's full again, this time on the off side and Negi opens up to drill that along the ground, just past cover in the gap for a powerful four
pitches it up again, Negi spots it and tonks it after clearing his front foot to the wide long on boundary, well into the crowds
bit too full outside off, that's a trademark Bravo inside-out drive over point with his head falling over, Morgan cuts it in
length delivery on off, Negi heaves it on the leg side towards deep midwicket
fullish on middle and leg, driven down to long on for one
101.7kph, slow offcutter on the stumps, Negi lets it come to him and defends it back
this time it's a slower one outside off, Negi waits and pokes but misses again
angles it across from back of length, that was much quicker with some bounce and Negi swung and missed
goes in the crease and pushes the straighter ball down to long on
superb slower delivery outside off, Bravo pokes at it and is beaten completely
in the block hole outside off, Bravo steers it straight to point
low full toss on the off stump, driven down to long off and DJ is off the mark

now Dhoni's bowled with a straighter and slower delivery, the crowd is wide awake! The dibbly-dobbly from Reddy kept a bit low as Dhoni looked to turn it to leg, missed it completely and lost his off and middle

and Faf has run himself out, that's such a bizarre run out! Dhoni pushed the straight full toss back towards the bowler but hit Faf, then the ball hit the umpire and went to the left of the bowler. Faf thought there was a run there and took off, but by the time he turned around, Reddy had picked the ball up from wide of the crease and hit the stumps even though he would have seen only one from that angle!
back of the hand slower ball on middle and leg, flicked to deep square leg for one
full on off again, driven squarer to deep point for one now
fullish outside off, Dhoni drives that into the covers and in the gap to call for two
it was right on the middle stump, but Faf took the risk and went down to ramp the ball on the full, fine to the leg side boundary. The fielder chases from fine leg but can't stop it
full on the leg side again, Faf comes down and flicks the low full toss on the pads wide of deep midwicket for two
Faf moves across to leg a long way, PK follows him and it goes down leg for a wide
low full toss on the off stump, pushed down easily to long on for one more
full on the leg stump now, Faf helps it to fine leg off the back foot
tries the yorker again, Dhoni moves across to flick the low full toss to leg
yorker on the off stump, driven down to long off for one
short of length towards the thigh pad, tucked towards square leg for one
126kph, slightly slower ball angled cross, Dhoni pushes it with the angle to long off
in the block hole and Faf blocks it to off for a quick single
fullish on the middle stump, Faf opens up and lofts it straight to the mid off boundary, since the fielder is in the circle, and gets a four
touch wider outside off, drives it off the back foot to sweeper cover
greets Boult with a firm drive outside off as he got room to swing his arms, and even turned his wrists over that cover drive

almost caught, almost run out! Henriques banged in a short one that rose on Faf, thick edge fell short of short third man and Faf wanted a single. He was sent back but had PK hit the stumps, Faf would have been in trouble
back of length outside off, Faf taps it late but straight to short third man
bouncer on the stumps at 134kph, Dhoni pivots around and hooks it to fine leg
back of length outside off without much room, Dhoni pushes it back with an inner edge
slow yorker on the stumps at 116kph, pushes it down to long on for one
the short ball is pulled just wide of midwicket from outside off and he gets four for that
drives the fullish one into the covers but bottom-edges it to long on for one
takes a step down again, Karn pitches it shorter on middle and Dhoni tucks it to leg
Dhoni on song! Dances down to take it on the full and slams it straight down the ground for a one-bounce four
takes his eyes off while attempting the same shot and laps it to fine leg for one
covers off stump and paddles the fullish ball fine on leg for two
loud appeal for MSD, this one hit him just a touch outside off, Dhoni came way down the track and missed it for a leg bye on the off side
short ball, angled in again, and Dhoni moves across to pull it fine to fine leg
full and going towards leg stump, helped with the angle to fine leg by Dhoni for two
he's got the big wicket of Raina, caught at long off! It wasn't a full delivery, was slightly slower, and Raina mistimed it down the ground, into the safe hands of Morgan
into the pads from middle and leg, helps it to fine leg for one
plomps his front foot forward and flicks the ball to leg from off for one
back of length and angling in, defends to leg off the back foot for one
starts this over with a wide down leg
leans forward to defend the ball that was turning in, keeper and bowler appeal for lbw. Was missing the off stump
dances down the track, nearly takes it on the full and lofts it straight down over the bowler's head for six!
short of length and turning away from off, slapped down to long on
comes down the track for the flat delivery, Raina tucks it to the leg side for one. Faf slips while turning around so it's only one
flighted in the block hole on middle, turned to the leg side with the wrists for one
turning in towards middle stump, helped with the turn to deep midwicket
angled across from outside off, Raina taps it late to third man now
112kph, back of length slower ball outisde off, Raina drives it late to point where Morgan stops it
full on the pads now, flicks it to square leg now
that's too much on the leg side, Faf flicks it late and fine down the leg side with his right leg in the air for four
fullish on the stumps, flicked to midwicket by Faf

another top-edge ends in a dismissal! Slower ball on the stumps from Henriques, Smith swipes it on the leg side with a cross-bat, gets a very high top edge and Vihari has to run in a lot from deep square leg to catch it. Excellent running catch
bit too full on the leg stump, that's in Raina's zone and he flicks it like a flamingo off the pads for a clean six. He hits those so well, great timing
back of length on the leg stump, Raina tucks it straight to square leg
accurate inswinging yorker on the middle stump, Smith digs it out to the leg side
slower one outside the off stump, Smith realises the ball has stopped on him and defends it to cover
fuller on the stumps, Smith flicks that high in the air with his wrists, well wide of deep midwicket for a one-bounce four
outswinger well outside off, Smith looks to slap it on leg, but misses. Just inside the wide line
on length on the off stump, no room at all and Raina defends it back
doesn't come in as much as Smith expects from outside off, he pokes and gets a thick edge to third man
much straighter, Smith responds with a straight bat too and lofts that effortlessly to the mid on boundary for six!
way outside the off stump with outswing, Smith chases and misses it. Called a wide
back of length on the legs, Raina tucks it off the pads behind square on leg
on the off stump with some shape, Raina blocks it back
that's how Raina gets off the mark, gets a length delivery on the off stump and he swings his arms with a big follow through to find the long on boundary
another short one, this time Smith is on top of it pulls it to the square-leg boundary from the middle of the bat for four
137kph, now the bouncer angled across from middle and off, Smith reacts late and can't pull that at all
mixes it up by angling the ball across, Smith swings and misses the length delivery
tries the yorker and Smith pushes the low, inswinging full toss down to mid on
fuller on the middle stump and Smith strikes this better, still from the inner half, and cleard midwicket for four
length delivery with some inswing on off, driven to midwicket off the inside edge
back of a length again, moving further away from the left hander, who watches it go past
gone now, Bhuvneshwar shortened the length considerably this time, and McCullum ended up chopping it into the stumps as he tried running it to third man
almost carried to short extra cover, Vihari has done quite well to stop this screamer from BMac, who had danced out and powered it again
gets away with an angled length ball into the pads, it rolls away square on the leg side
tight line outside off stump, he wafts at it from the crease, and underedges it close to the stumps
pushes a good length ball down the track, through Bhuvneshwar's grasp, mid off fields
third ball he pitches it up, and McCullum charges out, makes some room outside leg, and bashes it to the sweeper cover rope
short again, this time into the body, McCullum swivels and drags the pull past short fine leg
short and wide to his national captain, and McCullum violently crashes that over covers
outside edge now as Boult straightens it on off stump, a thick edge runs behind point, with Smith pushing at it from the crease
right up there, coming in late, this time he gets some bat down to work it to square leg
full and swinging in from Trent Boult first up, but headed down the leg side after rushing Smith
